arithmetic.R: full math.ulp(x) for nonzero computed values, zero for exact zero operations; nonzero-product underflow rejected separately
arithmetic.upper_operations: Every nonnegative budget product and sum rounded toward +infinity using math.nextafter; subnormal products cannot silently become zero

electrical.solve_coordinates: actual absolute V, not reference-shifted V
electrical.component_checks: Existing component-current and reference-shifted component-power checks unchanged
electrical.limitations: 32*eps is an existing engineering backward-residual margin, not a universal sparse-LU theorem or forward-accuracy certificate. At arbitrary voltage offsets, smaller-than-budget imbalance cannot be certified; component checks can reject unresolved driven drops.

thermal.rho_K: upper half-ulp(Tnew_i) if inc_i != 0; zero otherwise, including fixed nodes
thermal.capacity_allowance_J: 8*eps*C_i*(abs(Told_i)+abs(Tnew_i)) for active free rows, zero fixed/exact inactive rows
thermal.component_representation_J: sum_free capacity_allowance_J + sum_free_fixed_cut_edges dt*g_e*rho_free; free/free flux perturbations cancel
thermal.cap: Complete representation+evaluation allowance must be <=1e-6 of respective local/component scale; nonfinite budgets rejected
thermal.unchanged: Residual/scale formulas, loss-of-increment guard, physical inputs, sparse solver, backward Euler, partial-result API, and all rtol/atol/constants unchanged
thermal.scope: Only current-step reconstruction relative to previous accepted stored temperature; no invented historical uncertainty. Discrete equation acceptance does not establish time-discretization accuracy.
